Increasingly clear indications of the urgent need for reformulation in the entire UFO diffusion process that has been taking place in our country until now are emerging. And, just as the indications, expectations grow that the Phenomenon will be properly objectively and definitively placed, analyzed, and exposed.

Thus? Driven by our "scientific curiosity" and our
informative role, we initiated a true "informative battle" in
order to: i) detect the flaws, divergences, and irregularities
in the UFO diffusion executed in Brazil today; 2) correct such
flaws and irregularities with a massive UFO phenomenon
disclosure campaign, ensuring that divergences only exist
where understanding of the phenomenon itself, not its char-
acteristics, is concerned; and 3) aim to achieve the same cam-
paign, in detail, by observing, for example, the total absence
of social, scientific, academic, legislative, and other inter-
est in the subject, felt in the media that have not been rea-
chable, and similarly with other institutions, such as universi-
ties and research centers, that are supposed to be well-in-
formed on the UFO phenomenon.

Such a "UFO phenomenon disclosure campaign" is
exceptionally contradictory in Brazil, due to the lack of aca-
demic interest in the UFO phenomenon, its para-scientific
peculiarities, and its potential for investigation and theoriza-
tion. Consulting various universities (both public and pri-
vate), we found not only ignorance of the subject, but also
strong prejudice among academics and professors. These sym-
ptoms undeniably indicate the widespread lack of UFO informa-
tion dissemination in these institutions, considered cradles
of national culture, which means a huge failure in the long-
standing purpose that UFOlogists have had in raising public
awareness about the subject.

However, not only higher education institutions (in fact,
this situation is observed at all levels) lack high-level UFO in-
formation; our authorities, with rare exceptions, are practically
unaware of the subject and the level of understanding it has
reached in Brazil. Worse still, what is even more concerning
than the lack of knowledge about the subject is the totally in-
differently position that executive and legislative authorities
take with the nation, even in the New Republic. It is usual in
all serious countries that a subject of such magnitude be at
least considered. Here, this is not even contemplated!

Regrettably, in many other social and professional me-
dia, at every level, we also find similar states of ignorance,
prejudice, disinterest, and even "mental inertia" in continuing
a behavior based on such universally recognized, immutable,
and eternal laws, while the UFO phenomenon silently de-
stroy them and even brings down the impenetrability of mat-
ter.

But what are the true causes of these aforementioned
states, besides the traditional human ego and pride? Why
is the flying saucer subject not given the proper and deserv-
ed seriousness, and why is it insisted that this not be the
case?

It will be a spark for something much larger and more expressive, but it is a beginning that, including, has already started in the academic and legislative/governmental areas four months ago. Since UFOLOGY No. 1, over 1000 copies have been sent free of charge to approximately 150 Brazilian universities, 400 municipal public libraries, 40 private libraries, 90 regional and national general information vehicles, and over 500 authorities such as city councilors, state and federal deputies, senators, state secretaries, governors, mayors, advisors, etc. Although the return may be minimal, at this point, we will continue to make available as many copies of UFOLOGY as necessary for each edition to develop and continue the informative task. We believe and advocate for the rapid and definitive recognition of the UFO Phenomenon at all levels and by all layers of our society, and for this we will not measure efforts or work. In this true "battle" that UFOlogy's dissemination has become, we do not have a proper fighter or enemy. We have a target to be "worked" with the transcendence that represents the knowledge of UFO facts, a target that needs to become aware of a new and massive reality that, despite its future, has already begun. To do this, in this "battle," our ammunition is abundant and our resources unlimited: intelligent creativity, honesty, and a kind of "sense of duty" to inform what we know to be one of the most significant phenomena on Earth. All that remains is for us, UFOlogists, to declare war and set out without loss of time to our "battle." Or will it be our target that declares it?
